# Vendored packages

The tarballs in this directory are packages written by other people, pinned
here by file so an install never fetches a different copy. They are not
Stall's own code and are not covered by this repository's LICENSE: each is
under the MIT License, with the copyright holders below, read from the
package's own LICENSE file where it ships one and from its source headers
where it does not. The MIT text they are granted under follows the list.

- `b58-ts-0.1.0.tgz` — b58-ts 0.1.0: Copyright (c) 2024 The Bitcoin developers (source headers; the package ships no LICENSE file)
- `chronik-client-4.3.1.tgz` — chronik-client 4.3.1: Copyright (c) 2023-2025 The Bitcoin developers (source headers; no LICENSE file)
- `ecash-agora-4.2.5.tgz` — ecash-agora 4.2.5: Copyright (c) 2024-2026 The Bitcoin developers (source headers; no LICENSE file)
- `ecash-lib-4.13.0.tgz` — ecash-lib 4.13.0: Copyright (c) 2023-2026 The Bitcoin developers (source headers; no LICENSE file)
- `ecash-wallet-6.1.0.tgz` — ecash-wallet 6.1.0: Copyright (c) 2025-2026 The Bitcoin developers (source headers; no LICENSE file)
- `ecashaddrjs-2.0.0.tgz` — ecashaddrjs 2.0.0: Copyright (c) 2017-2020 Emilio Almansi; Copyright (c) 2023 Bitcoin ABC (its LICENSE file); its source headers also name Copyright (c) 2017 Pieter Wuille, Copyright (c) 2024 Bitcoin ABC and Copyright (c) 2023-2025 The Bitcoin developers
- `noble-hashes-2.3.0.tgz` — @noble/hashes 2.3.0: Copyright (c) 2022 Paul Miller (https://paulmillr.com) (its LICENSE file)
- `qrcode-generator-1.4.4.tgz` — qrcode-generator 1.4.4: Copyright (c) 2009-2016 Kazuhiko Arase (source headers; no LICENSE file)

The site's own notices for what it sends to a browser — these packages
among them, with the rest of what they depend on — are in
`public/licenses.txt`, served at `/licenses.txt`.
